_README: Copy to search-profile.json (gitignored). Change "market" and optional cities for this person.
_market: AE = UAE (default). Also: GB, US, DE, IN, SA. See markets/README.md to add more.

boards._note: MENA board (UAE/KSA). Skipped automatically for markets without baytCountry. Apify only.
Country taken from markets/<id>.json → indeedCountryCode / jobspyCountryIndeed.
JobSpy first even when Allow paid (saves Apify). Apify only if that query returns 0. Default is pastWeek, then pastMonth if empty. Pin input.datePosted to disable widening.

_moreBoards: Optional/flaky: google, glassdoor (often blocked — leave off). DE free: arbeitsagentur, arbeitnow, berlinstartupjobs, munichstartup, pegel, nomado24, stepstone, xing, kimeta, heise, germantechjobs; zip_recruiter (US/CA), naukri (IN), bdjobs (BD). Toggle in the UI Portals tab.
_limitPerQuery: Jobs per title×city query. Raise it in the UI if you want a wider page. Each title×city×board can become one Apify run when paid.
_fetchConcurrency: How many portals search at once (1–8). JobSpy sites (Indeed/LinkedIn) stay at most 2 so the same IP is less likely to get blocked. CLI: --concurrency 4.
_linkedinFetchApplicants: Best-effort public LinkedIn applicant counts: at most 20 detail pages and a 20-second start budget per query; stops on blocking. Set false to skip extra requests.
_linkedinFetchDescription: true = JobSpy opens every LinkedIn listing for the full JD (slow). false = titles/metadata only; descriptions still come from Indeed and DE portals when the same job appears there.
_preferJobspy: Only applies when Allow paid is OFF. With --allow-paid / Allow paid, Apify runs first (JobSpy is fallback).
_maxApifyRuns: Hard cap on paid Apify actor runs per fetch. 0 = unlimited.
_cities: Omit cities to use markets/<id>.json defaults. Override e.g. "cities": [{ "where": "Berlin", "radiusKm": 50 }]

filters._titlePatterns: Pulled from profile.search.includeTitlePatterns / excludeTitlePatterns at runtime.
